name: @earshot/understanding
description: Earshot's understanding step, pure TypeScript with no DOM and no Node APIs: the name toolkit (normalization, Double Metaphone, pg_trgm-compatible trigrams, Jaro-Winkler, initials, token alignment, the homophone list), the entity linker (the per-session index, candidates, features, a calibrated logistic model, and the link / ask / new decision), and later the witness comparison, the value normalizers, and the faithfulness check.
